tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently visited a popular tourist attraction near your college called 'Mountain View Park.' While you enjoyed the beautiful scenery, you have some concerns about the park. You want to suggest some improvements to the park administrator, Ms. Harris. Write an email to Ms. Harris.
bullets: Describe what you enjoyed about your visit to the park.
Explain your concern about the litter and lack of waste disposal facilities.
Suggest measures that could be taken to keep the park clean and enjoyable for all visitors.
tasks.subject: Suggestions for improving park cleanliness
